Khushi dimaag ka ek attitude hai, jo har halat mein khush rehne ki zid se paida hota hai.
Joy dil ki shanti hai.
Azaadi bade dimag ka privilege hai.
Azaadi insaan ki mahanata ki pariksha hai.
Azadi manavta ka satya hai.
Unse bada ghulam koi nahi jo jhootha azaadi ka vishwas rakhte hain.
Azadi bolne ki kshamta hai.
Sachha aanand ek shukriya bhare dil ki gehraiyon se aata hai.
Khushi dil ka khamosh sangeet hai.
Khushi khush rehne ke dridh nishchay se aati hai.
Khushi ek titli hai, jo piche bhagne par door rehti hai, par shant baithne par aap par baith sakti hai.
Aazadi hone ka haq hai.
Khushi ek itra hai jise doosron par chirke bina kuch aap par nahi lagta.
Khushi lambai ki kami ko unchai se poora kar deti hai.
Khushi ek sooraj ki kiran hai jo hazaron rangon se guzar sakti hai.
Rachnatmakta ke liye azadi zaroori hai.
Khushi khud ko talaashne ka safar hai.
Khushi tab hai jab aapka kehna aur karna ek ho.
Pahad jeeto, log nahi.
Pahad pure joy ke raaz fusfusate hain.
Azaadi zindagi se pyar karne ka sabse pakka tarika hai.
Azadi ke bina khushi nahi hai.
Azadi keemat hai.
